sessionStart.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.work\copilot-cli' | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path '.work\copilot-cli\session.log' -Value ('[{0}] sessionStart' -f (Get-Date -Format o))

sessionEnd.bash: mkdir -p .work/copilot-cli; input=$(cat | tr -d '\r'); reason=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"reason"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); printf '[%s] sessionEnd reason=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "${reason:-unspecified}" >> .work/copilot-cli/session.log
sessionEnd.powershell: $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try{$e=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{$e=$null}; $reason='unspecified'; if($e -and $e.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'reason'){$reason=[string]$e.reason}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.work\copilot-cli' | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path '.work\copilot-cli\session.log' -Value ('[{0}] sessionEnd reason={1}' -f (Get-Date -Format o), $reason)

userPromptSubmitted.bash: mkdir -p .work/copilot-cli; input=$(cat | tr -d '\r'); prompt=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"prompt"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\(.*\)".*/\1/p'); printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "${prompt:-$input}" >> .work/copilot-cli/prompts.log
userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try{$e=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{$e=$null}; $prompt=$raw; if($e -and $e.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'prompt'){$prompt=[string]$e.prompt}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.work\copilot-cli' | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path '.work\copilot-cli\prompts.log' -Value ('[{0}] {1}' -f (Get-Date -Format o), $prompt)

postToolUse.bash: mkdir -p .work/copilot-cli; input=$(cat | tr -d '\r'); tool=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"toolName"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); hash=$(printf '%s' "$input" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); printf '[%s] tool=%s argHash=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "${tool:-unknown}" "$hash" >> .work/copilot-cli/tool-usage.log
postToolUse.powershell: $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try{$e=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json}catch{$e=$null}; $tool='unknown'; if($e -and $e.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'toolName'){$tool=[string]$e.toolName}; $sha=[System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create(); $bytes=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($raw); $hash=([BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash($bytes))).Replace('-','').ToLowerInvariant(); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.work\copilot-cli' | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path '.work\copilot-cli\tool-usage.log' -Value ('[{0}] tool={1} argHash={2}' -f (Get-Date -Format o), $tool, $hash)

agentStop.powershell: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '.work\copilot-cli' | Out-Null; Add-Content -Path '.work\copilot-cli\session.log' -Value ('[{0}] agentStop' -f (Get-Date -Format o))

subagentStart.bash: printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"Write worker artifacts under .work/copilot-cli/<task-slug>/{analysis,plans,missions,final}/. Preserve Andromeda invariants: no gRPC, no JSON application surface, no ad hoc SQL application surface, and WAL-before-visible-commit."}'
subagentStart.powershell: [pscustomobject]@{additionalContext='Write worker artifacts under .work/copilot-cli/<task-slug>/{analysis,plans,missions,final}/. Preserve Andromeda invariants: no gRPC, no JSON application surface, no ad hoc SQL application surface, and WAL-before-visible-commit.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
